about_the_game:
Jigsaw Jab is a 2D top-down, wave-based action game fused with jigsaw puzzle assembly.
Play as a floating hand in a surreal pixel arena. Poke for precise hits, Slam for crowd control, then grab defeated enemies and snap their pieces onto the central board.

How it plays:

  • Fight: Enemies emerge from every edge of the arena. Choose precision strikes to pick off individuals or unleash slams to clear crowds and stun foes.

  • Collect: Once defeated, grab, rotate, and drag the pieces across the board to assemble.

  • Place: Snap each piece into its rightful place on the central jigsaw board. Correct fits reward you with healing and progression; missed slots leave gaps and pressure builds.

  • Repeat: Alternate between frantic combat and fast puzzle-placements until the board is done or your hand breaks.

Why you’ll keep playing:

  • This is not just “survive waves” and not just “solve a puzzle.” It’s the tension of facing down attackers and the satisfaction of locking pieces into place under pressure.

  • Control is immediate, readable and geared for speed: move. Strike. Grab. Place. Get back to the fight.

  • Each run isn’t a slow puzzle turn-by-turn; it’s rapid, kinetic, blast-and-fit gameplay that replays again and again.

  • Whether you have ten minutes or an hour, the loop adapts. Clear one board, try for better speed, harder waves, cleaner fits.

Jump in. Send rogue pieces flying. Snap the Jigsaw back together. 🫵⚔️🧩
